auth: fix VideoGrant permission doc to match actual defaults (#1918)

The comment claimed an all-or-nothing default. In fact each of CanPublish,
CanSubscribe and CanPublishData defaults to granted when left unset, evaluated
independently, and CanPublishData falls back to the effective CanPublish value.
